DailyScoreEntry.title: DailyScoreEntry
DailyScoreEntry.description: A verified player's best Daily Challenge run score for a specific UTC date.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player

dateKey.description: UTC date key (YYYY-MM-DD) identifying the 24-hour challenge window

pilotName.description: Public pilot callsign displayed on the leaderboard (no PII)

shipId.description: Identifier of the fixed daily vessel class

shipName.description: Display name of the fixed daily vessel class

mutatorName.description: Name of the daily sector mutator

score.description: Highest score achieved in this daily challenge window

kills.description: Enemies neutralized during the best daily run

survivalTime.description: Survival duration in seconds during the best daily run

level.description: Pilot level reached during the best daily run

bossesDefeated.description: Bosses defeated during the best daily run

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily entry was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily best score was last updated

/daily_scores/{entryId}.description: Stores each player's personal best score for a given 24-hour UTC Daily Challenge window, keyed by {dateKey}_{uid}.
